title: Closing Date Notice Age and Builder Extended Rate Lock Extensions
content:
Calloway's closing date notices to the buyer are dated communications, and the age of the latest one counts when a Builder Extended Rate Lock is extended.

**Standard.** Where the buyer's latest closing date notice from Calloway is dated 30 or fewer calendar days before the extension, 2 days are added to the days to cover; where it is dated more than 30 but no more than 60 days before, 1 day is added; otherwise none is added. The days are added before the days to cover are rounded up to whole increments.

## Age bands

| Age of the latest closing date notice on the extension date | Days added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 days | 2 |
| 31 to 60 days | 1 |
| more than 60 days, or no closing date notice | 0 |

The notice is read from the Home Purchase Agreement ledger of the agreement the lock finances; only the latest closing date notice counts.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Latest notice dated 1 May, extension written 31 May: 30 days, adds 2.
- Extension written 1 June: 31 days, adds 1.
- Extension written 30 June: 60 days, adds 1; written 1 July: 61 days, adds none.
